stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, K W Nelson Interior Design and Contracting Group Limited offers specialized interior design and contracting solutions, primarily targeting commercial spaces across the People's Republic of China. Their comprehensive suite of services spans from initial pre-lease consultation and bespoke interior design to meticulous space planning, project management, fitting-out, construction, custom maintenance, and ongoing after-sales support. The firm caters to a diverse clientele of multinational corporations, representing sectors such as banking, retail, healthcare, legal, hospitality, education, energy, insurance, telecommunications, property, and logistics. Originally incorporated in 2009 under the name K W Nelson Interior Architect Group Limited, the company adopted its current moniker, K W Nelson Interior Design and Contracting Group Limited, in August 2017. Its headquarters are situated in Quarry Bay, Hong Kong.
